<!-- mls fileReference="_102020_/l2/agentDefsL2/steps/pages50/prompt.md" enhancement="_blank" -->
Describe exactly one page in two presentations: desktop and mobile. Call `submitD2Pages` once.
Each description explains the user's objective, information, actions, loading/empty/error states and
accessible interaction. Preserve the same business tasks and data on both devices. Mobile may discuss
touch, reading priority and constrained space, but it must not remove capabilities. Desktop and mobile
must differ in presentation prose without prescribing a layout.
Do not emit HTML, CSS, coordinates, columns, grids, wireframes, fixed sections, component tags or a
mandatory molecule variant. Do not invent statistics, methods, data, routes, permissions or APIs. The
approved shared object is the closed capability vocabulary: list every action/state/scenary used in
`capabilityRefs`, identically for both devices. Suggest only groupIds present in the compact inventory;
groups are optional aids for the future designer and never become compulsory components.
Names, paths, ids, pipeline items, dependencies and skill references are emitted by code. Return only
the schema fields. On repair, correct the whole two-device unit using the diagnostic and prior answer.

"descriptions": [
"The professional’s objective is to consult the daily agenda and review only the consultations linked to themselves. For each consultation they can learn who the patient is, when it is scheduled, and whether it has already been attended, without seeing anyone else’s agenda.",
"They locate those consultations of the day by consultation identity, patient, professional, scheduled time, and attendance situation, and they can request another page of results when they need to continue. After a match is found they inspect the same patient, time, and attended situation before deciding to act.",
"To register an attendance they select their own consultation so its identity is known, confirm its data, supply the required attendance details, and may write an attendance note. Recording attendance marks that consultation as attended, keeps the note on it, and then refreshes the daily agenda so the new situation is visible. The base scenery supports locating and inspecting; the register-attendance scenery supports completing that record once a consultation is selected.",
"When the page is idle they can start locating consultations. While consultations are loading they are told the day’s agenda is still being retrieved. An empty outcome tells them there are no matching consultations. Success presents the consultations they located. An error tells them the agenda could not be retrieved so they may try again. While attendance is saving they are told the record is in progress; success confirms the attended situation and the note; an error explains that recording did not complete so they can correct the details or note and retry.",
"Accessible interaction on the desktop treats keyboard and pointer as equivalent: the professional can move focus through the day’s consultations, into attendance details and the optional note, and onto recording attendance. Every control exposes a name and purpose, and loading, empty, success, error, and attended situation are announced as text rather than by color or placement alone."
